name: sheetsdata
description: Electronic component datasheets for AI agents — pinouts, specs, package info and design checks from manufacturer PDFs.
author: Octoco Ltd

authentication.instructions: Sign in with OAuth 2.1 (dynamic client registration, PKCE): Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Zed, Goose, Amp and most other MCP clients open a browser tab the first time they connect. For CI, scripts or clients without MCP OAuth, create an API key at https://sheetsdata.com/dashboard/keys and send it as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'.

tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Find parts by part number or keyword across JLCPCB, Mouser and DigiKey, merged by MPN, with stock, price and datasheet status from each.

tools.name: find_parts
tools.description: Find parts that meet numeric specs with units (e.g. Vin ≥ 24 V, Iout ≥ 2 A), package or stock; each check reports pass, fail or unknown with its source.

tools.name: get_part_details
tools.description: A part's key parameters, package, pricing, stock and datasheet status, by MPN or LCSC number.

tools.name: check_bom
tools.description: Check up to 20 BOM lines for lifecycle, stock against quantity, single-distributor sourcing, datasheet status and stale prices.

tools.name: prefetch_datasheets
tools.description: Start reading up to 20 datasheets at once, so a whole BOM is ready before you ask about it.

tools.name: check_extraction_status
tools.description: Report how far a datasheet that is still being read has got.

tools.name: read_datasheet
tools.description: Any section of a datasheet as text and tables (summary, pinout, electrical, absolute maximum ratings, package, or any heading), or a search within one datasheet.

tools.name: search_datasheets
tools.description: Search every datasheet read so far by meaning, e.g. 'LDO with PSRR above 70 dB'.

tools.name: compare_parts
tools.description: Compare 2-5 parts side by side: parameters, package, pricing, stock and datasheet summaries.

tools.name: find_alternative
tools.description: Find drop-in and functional substitutes for a part, ranked by spec, package and stock match, with notes on each match.

tools.name: check_design_fit
tools.description: Check operating conditions against the datasheet's absolute maximum and recommended ratings: PASS, WARNING or FAIL per condition, with the datasheet row it used.

tools.name: analyze_image
tools.description: Read values off a datasheet figure: a characteristic graph, package drawing or pin diagram.

tools.name: request_datasheet_upload
tools.description: Get a private signed upload link for a datasheet PDF we couldn't find (datasheet_status 'no_source' or 'unsupported'). Free; the fee is charged only on confirm.

tools.name: confirm_datasheet_upload
tools.description: Verify an uploaded PDF (SHA-256, valid PDF, MPN on the first page), charge the upload fee and read it into your organisation's private library.

prompts.name: component-selection
prompts.description: Walk through selecting a component: define requirements, search candidates, compare specs, validate design fit.

prompts.name: bom-review
prompts.description: Review a bill of materials: look up each part, check stock and lifecycle, flag risks, suggest alternatives.

prompts.name: datasheet-deep-dive
prompts.description: Deep-dive into a specific part: summarize, extract pinout, electrical specs, absolute max ratings, and application circuit.

prompts.name: design-validation
prompts.description: Validate a design: check each component against operating conditions, flag out-of-spec parameters.

prompts.name: second-source
prompts.description: Find second-source alternatives for a part: match package, specs, and availability across providers.

prompts.name: interface-check
prompts.description: Check electrical and protocol compatibility between two ICs on a shared bus (SPI, I2C, UART). Verifies voltage levels (VOH/VOL vs VIH/VIL), timing, pull-up requirements, and flags level-shifter needs.

prompts.name: firmware-kickstart
prompts.description: Extract register map, initialization sequence, and protocol details from a peripheral IC datasheet. Generates a firmware integration guide with register writes, transaction examples, and common pitfalls.

prompts.name: thermal-review
prompts.description: Thermal and derating analysis: compare operating conditions against absolute maximum AND recommended limits, estimate junction temperature from RthJA, check SOA derating curves, and flag exposed-pad requirements.

resources.description: Recommended tool workflow for component selection.
The 8 most common datasheet interpretation mistakes: abs max confusion, typical vs worst-case, thermal derating, voltage level mismatches, I2C/SPI gotchas, decoupling, exposed pads, lifecycle risks.
Hardware design review checklist covering power supply, signal interfaces, component selection, and firmware integration.
